sheet.interiors.structure.8x8.notes: Interior floors, walls, corners, doors, windows, stairs, and hatches. Generated source retained under asset/Originals/interiors/.

sheet.interiors.mushroom-structure.8x8.notes: Mossy mushroom-cottage floors, root-timber walls, corners, doors, windows, hatches, eaves and fences. GPT-2 generated source retained under asset/Originals/interiors/generated-sheets/.

sheet.interiors.mushroom-large-furniture.notes: Mushroom-cottage beds, tables, hearths, shelves and counters. GPT-2 generated source retained under asset/Originals/interiors/generated-sheets/.

sheet.interiors.mushroom-floor-decor.8x8.notes: Flat mushroom-cottage floor decals: stepping stones, clover, flowers, moss, pebbles, roots, leaf litter, tiny mushrooms. GPT-2 generated source retained under asset/Originals/interiors/generated-sheets/.

sheet.interiors.mushroom-room-shell.8x7.notes: Mushroom-cottage room shell cut into world-aligned 128 px cells (rows 0-5) plus walkable doorway floor (row 6). GPT-2 generated source retained under asset/Originals/interiors/generated-sheets/.

sheet.houses.mushroom.2x1.notes: Top-down mushroom house exteriors (frame 0 wide cap, frame 1 round cap) generated with Magnific GPT-2; sources in asset/Originals/houses/, packed by scripts/houses/normalize-mushroom-houses.py.

sheet.houses.workshop.2x1.notes: Slimeshire Workshop exterior (frame 0 ruined, frame 1 restored) generated with Magnific GPT-2; sources in asset/Originals/houses/generated/, packed by scripts/houses/pack-workshop.py.

sheet.rocks.3x1.notes: Large static rock objects; all three frames are runtime candidates.

sheet.rocks.8x3.notes: Rock artwork only. Collider geometry and behavior live in individual object archetype files.

sheet.resources.4x2.notes: Top row contains large resource piles; bottom row contains small walk-over collectible piles. Frames can also be reused as inventory thumbnails.

character.enemy.meadow-spider.notes: The Meadow spider of level 1 (the original yellow spider sheet, same 8x10 layout as the orb-weaver's), so it is never mistaken for a Gloop Forest orb-weaver (playtest 2026-10-01).

sheet.items.chapter-2.5x2.notes: Chapter 2 item icons: 0 weaver fang, 1 iron bar, 2 Reinforced Pickaxe, 3 iron spear, 4 iron axe (5-9 free). Magnific GPT-2 on white, cut out and packed by scripts/items/pack-chapter-2-art.py.

sheet.rocks.iron-ore.2x1.notes: Iron ore node (frame 0) and its mined-out rubble (frame 1); only the Reinforced Pickaxe breaks it. Magnific GPT-2 on white, cut out and packed by scripts/items/pack-chapter-2-art.py.

effect.player.stretch-lash.notes: Stretch Lash goo tendril (frames 0-3 reach out, 4-5 hit with a splat, 6-7 pull back), drawn at twice the display size. Magnific GPT-2 sources in asset/Originals/effects/stretch-lash/, packed by scripts/effects/pack-stretch-lash.py.

object.training-dummy.notes: Straw training dummy for the playground's feel yard (weapons and abilities on something that never fights back). Magnific GPT-2 with Magnific background removal; source asset/Originals/props/training-dummy/, packed by scripts/props/pack-training-dummy.py.

object.lash-bell-post.notes: Bell post rung by the Stretch Lash (frame 0 rest, 1 and 2 the bell swung). Magnific GPT-2 source asset/Originals/effects/stretch-lash/bell-post-b.png, packed by scripts/effects/pack-lash-bell.py.

weapon.player.iron-tools-tiles.notes: Chapter 2 weapon art: the iron spear (diagonal, plain and thrust) like starter-spears, the iron axe and the Reinforced Pickaxe upright like stone-tools. Magnific GPT-2 on white, cut out and packed by scripts/weapons/pack-iron-tools.py.
